## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` new capability
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `docs` documentation only
- [ ] `ci` pipeline change

## Checklist

- [ ] `terraform fmt -check` and `terraform validate` pass
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes
- [ ] I read the `terraform plan` and it matches what I intended
- [ ] No secrets, state files, plan files or real `*.tfvars` are included
- [ ] Docs (README, module README, ADR) updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
